sources.snippet: translategemma-4b-it is a lightweight translation model developed by google that handles text and image-based translation across 55 languages. Built on the Gemma 3 architecture, this 4-billion-parameter model operates with a 2K-token context window and processes images normalized to 896x896 resolution (encoded to 256 tokens each).
